tips.long_session: Use /clear when you switch to a different task and /compact in long sessions, so each turn does not re-send a huge context.
tips.cache_miss: When you come back from a pause, compact the conversation or start a new session instead of continuing a cold one.
tips.resumed_session: If you return to a task after hours or days, start a new session or use /compact before continuing; resuming a session with a large context forces the entire context to be written to cache again.
tips.huge_tool_result: Limit file reads to the lines you need and filter the output of tests or installs (for example with tail or grep) before it enters the conversation.
tips.expensive_model: Use a lighter model for routine tasks such as small edits, renames or quick questions, and keep Opus for the hard problems.
tips.subagents: Subagents start with their own context and their tokens add up. Use them for wide searches, and ask them to return short summaries.

cli.help:
Claude Code Token Dashboard

Commands:
  npm run example   Dashboard with made-up example data
  npm run check     Check that the tool understands your files
  npm start         Dashboard with your real data

Advanced options (bin/cli.js):
  --example         Use the made-up files in example/
  --check           Print the parser report and exit
  --data <path>     Read .jsonl files from this folder
  --lang <es|en>    Language of the terminal output
  --no-open         Do not open the browser automatically
  --help, -h        Show this help
  --version, -v     Show the version

Environment variables:
  PORT              Port to listen on (default 3000)
  CLAUDE_DATA_DIR   Folder with the Claude Code data
